articles.title: UN High-Level Panel on AI Governance & India's DPI Framework
articles.summary: India advocates adopting its open-source Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) model to democratize global AI governance and bridge the digital divide.
prelims: DPI core pillars include Digital Identity (Aadhaar), Fast Payments (UPI), and Consent-based Data Sharing (Account Aggregator).
Global Partnership on Artificial Intelligence (GPAI) is a multi-stakeholder initiative hosted by the OECD.
IndiaAI Mission focuses on building compute capacity, foundational models, and safe deployment frameworks.
articles.mains: Use in GS-2 answers on international technology governance, soft power projection through tech diplomacy, and digital inclusion.

articles.title: RBI Issues Guidelines on Climate-Related Financial Risk Disclosures
articles.summary: RBI mandates climate risk stress testing and green finance disclosures for Regulated Entities to safeguard macro-financial stability.
prelims: Climate risk is categorized into Physical Risk (extreme events) and Transition Risk (policy/market shifts).
Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) provides the global framework for climate risk reporting.
Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS) is a central bank network fostering climate risk management in banking.
articles.mains: Use in GS-3 Economy answers concerning banking sector resilience, green finance mechanisms, and systemic economic risks.

articles.title: CACP Recommends Integrating Eco-Services Incentives into MSP Regime
articles.summary: The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices suggests incentivizing eco-friendly farming practices alongside MSP calculations.
prelims: CACP is an attached office of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare established in 1965.
MSP is currently announced for 22 mandated crops plus Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP) for sugarcane.
CACP considers cost concepts like A2, A2+FL, and C2 when evaluating production economics.
articles.mains: Use in GS-3 Agriculture questions regarding sustainable farming, MSP regime reforms, and crop diversification strategy.

articles.title: Deep Ocean Mission: MATSYA 6000 Advances to Shallow Water Phase
articles.summary: India's human submersible MATSYA 6000 reaches key milestones in testing for deep-sea resource exploration.
prelims: MATSYA 6000 is designed by NIOT under the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES) to carry 3 humans to 6,000 meters depth.
Central Indian Ocean Basin holds exploration rights for Polymetallic Nodules allocated by International Seabed Authority (ISA).
Polymetallic nodules primarily contain nickel, copper, cobalt, and manganese essential for green transitions.
articles.mains: Use in GS-3 Science & Tech and Environment answers on Blue Economy policy, critical mineral security, and oceanographic research.

articles.title: Supreme Court Reaffirms Procedural Guarantees Under Article 300A
articles.summary: The Supreme Court rules that procedural fairness and fair compensation remain constitutional guarantees under Article 300A.
prelims: Right to Property was removed from Fundamental Rights via the 44th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1978.
Article 300A states that no person shall be deprived of property save by authority of law.
Article 300A is a constitutional/statutory right protecting citizens against arbitrary executive actions.
articles.mains: Use in GS-2 Constitutional Law answers on the doctrine of eminent domain, evolution of rights, and judicial protection of constitutional liberties.
